title: Add hover/selected states for Success Criteria tabs and ensure Impact vs 90-Day Plan are distinct

requirements.text: Add clear hover, focus, and selected (active) visual states for all tab buttons in the Success Criteria module (the four success criteria tabs plus the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” buttons), so users can visually tell what is interactive, what is hovered, and what is selected.

quotes: when hovered should react or respond like colour change or selected colour.

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, hovering any tab button (including Impact and 90-Day Plan) visibly changes its styling (e.g., background, border, or text color) without causing layout shift.
Using keyboard navigation (Tab + arrow keys/Enter/Space as applicable), the focused tab button has a visible focus indicator.
The currently selected success-criteria tab has a clearly distinct selected styling that is different from the hover styling.
Hover/focus/selected styles work in both light and dark modes.

requirements.text: Ensure the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” controls in the Success Criteria module are clearly separated as two distinct buttons (not visually merged/overwritten) and that each triggers only its respective scroll target (Impact scrolls to the Impact section; 90-Day Plan scrolls to the Roadmap section).
acceptanceCriteria: “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” render as two distinct tab/button elements with readable labels at all common viewport sizes (mobile through desktop).
Clicking/tapping “Impact” scrolls to the section with id="impact" and does not scroll to the roadmap section.
Clicking/tapping “90-Day Plan” scrolls to the section with id="roadmap" and does not scroll to the impact section.
No label text overlap/overwriting occurs between these two controls at any viewport size.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn UI components); compose/override styles from consuming components instead.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add new sections or change the content of the Impact or 90-Day Roadmap sections beyond what is needed for correct navigation/interaction.
Do not introduce new backend functionality; this is a frontend-only fix.
